The excerpt relies almost entirely on exteriority and lacks interiority. The narrative is told from an objective, observational perspective, focusing on the physical setting, the characters' appearances, their body language, and their spoken dialogue about politics. We are never given direct access to the inner thoughts, personal memories, or subjective emotional experiences of any of the characters. Because there is no introspection to balance the external action and dialogue, the piece does not achieve emotional flexibility.
